name: Lotus Root
siboNotes: Lotus root is well-tolerated and provides beneficial resistant starch when cooked and cooled, which may support healthy gut bacteria balance.
preparationTips: Slice and soak in acidulated water (water with lemon juice) to prevent browning
Can be eaten raw in salads when young and tender, or cooked in stir-fries and soups
Remove the outer skin with a vegetable peeler before slicing
Cook until tender but still slightly crisp for best texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and potassium
